title: Clara Luz Flores Returns to the Forefront of Morena in Nuevo León: Career and the NXIVM Case
author: José Shaddai Olvera Torres
content:
_This article by[José Shaddai Olvera
Torres](https://elchamuco.com.mx/author/shaddai/) originally appeared in the
[September 29, 2026 edition of El Chamuco y los Hijos del
Averno](https://elchamuco.com.mx/2026/09/29/clara-luz-flores-vuelve-al-primer-
plano-de-morena-en-nuevo-leon-trayectoria-y-caso-nxivm/), a Mexican outlet
covering politics and investigative reporting._

_(September 29, 2026).— Morena 's new coordinator in Nuevo León already ran
for governor in 2021, and during that campaign faced questions over her
relationship with NXIVM and Keith Raniere._

Clara Luz Flores Carrales will once again head up Morena's project in Nuevo
León. On September 28, she was named state coordinator for the Defense of the
Transformation and National Sovereignty, a party post that positions her for
the process to decide the party's candidacy for state government in 2027.

Her return puts her political career back under scrutiny, along with the
episode tied to **NXIVM** , the organization led by Keith Raniere, who was
sentenced in the United States to 120 years in prison on charges that included
sex trafficking and racketeering.

## From PRI Militant to Morena

A lawyer by training from the Universidad Regiomontana, Clara Luz Flores was
born in Monclova, Coahuila, and built her political career in Nuevo León. She
served as a local deputy and was elected mayor of General Escobedo three
times.

She is married to Abel Guerra, also a former mayor of General Escobedo and a
politician with his own ties to the PRI. Flores built much of her career
inside that party before joining the Morena project.

She left the PRI in 2020, and the following year ran as the candidate of
Morena, the PT, the PVEM and Nueva Alianza Nuevo León for governor.

In the 2021 election she won **14% of the vote and placed third**. Samuel
García, of Movimiento Ciudadano, won 36.7%; Adrián de la Garza, of the PRI-PRD
coalition, took 27.9%; and Fernando Larrazábal, of the PAN, got 18.3%.

Now Morena is once again putting her at the head of its political structure in
Nuevo León ahead of the 2027 election.

## Her Return to the Federal Government

The 2021 electoral defeat didn't mean Flores Carrales's retirement from
politics.

On June 21, 2022, she was named head of the **Executive Secretariat of the
National Public Security System (SESNSP)** under the government of Andrés
Manuel López Obrador. The appointment was formalized by the Secretariat of
Security and Civilian Protection.

She later held other posts in the federal government and, under the
administration of Claudia Sheinbaum, led the Unit for Religious Affairs,
Prevention and Reconstruction of the Social Fabric at the Interior Ministry.

Her new party assignment brings her back to the political stage in Nuevo León,
this time as Morena's state coordinator.

## The Clara Luz Flores and NXIVM Episode

The most contentious episode of her 2021 campaign was her relationship with
**NXIVM** and its founder, Keith Raniere.

On March 24, 2021, a video recorded in 2016 surfaced showing Flores in a
personal conversation with Raniere. The footage was used during the campaign
by her PRI rival, Adrián de la Garza. _El País_ reported that the encounter
was part of a longer recording, and that Flores had taken part in NXIVM's
personal-development programs.

The release of the video raised questions because, before it surfaced, Flores
had publicly played down any relationship with NXIVM. She later acknowledged
that she had met Raniere and had taken courses with the organization.

In an interview with Julio Astillero, before acknowledging the encounter,
Flores had brushed off questions about NXIVM.

> "I don't know what NXIVM you're talking about."
>
> Clara Luz Flores, in a 2021 interview with Julio Astillero

After the video came out, she acknowledged the encounter and explained that it
had taken place before she knew about the crimes Raniere had committed. She
also said she had been deceived by the organization and that her involvement
was limited to taking its courses.

### What's Documented About Her Relationship With NXIVM?

Flores's relationship with NXIVM isn't limited to a photograph or a chance
encounter with Raniere.

_El País_ reported in 2021, citing the organization's internal documents, that
Flores took part in the **Executive Success Programs (ESP)** , worked as a
_coach_ , and reached the rank of yellow belt with a stripe within that
training system.

That detail matters because it contrasts with Flores's initial explanation of
her relationship with NXIVM, and it helps explain why the episode became a
central issue during the 2021 campaign.

## NXIVM, DOS and Keith Raniere's Crimes

NXIVM presented itself publicly as an organization devoted to personal-
development and leadership courses. Inside its structure operated **DOS** , a
secret group that, according to the investigations and the judicial process in
the United States, controlled women through a system of obedience and
compromising material used as collateral.

Keith Raniere was found guilty in the United States of crimes that included
sex trafficking, racketeering and conspiracy to commit forced labor. In
October 2020 he was sentenced to **120 years in prison**.

The existence of that criminal structure is a judicially established fact.
That history, however, must be distinguished from Flores's specific
relationship with NXIVM.

**The sources consulted do not show that Clara Luz Flores took part in the
crimes for which Raniere was convicted, that she belonged to DOS, or that she
was criminally charged over those acts.** Her documented participation in
NXIVM programs and her encounter with Raniere do not, on their own, make her
criminally responsible for the organization's activities.

The documented issue that did raise questions during the 2021 campaign was the
gap between her initial statements about NXIVM and her later acknowledgment of
her relationship with the organization. _El País_ reported that Flores went as
far as admitting she had lied about her ties to Raniere.

## Clara Luz Flores Returns to the Electoral Stage

Five years after that campaign, Clara Luz Flores is once again heading up
Morena's project in Nuevo León.

Her career combines municipal, legislative and federal posts with a long
stretch of PRI militancy, her move to Morena, and her 2021 candidacy.

Now, her appointment as state coordinator opens a new chapter on the road to
2027. Any eventual run for governor will have to be decided later, through the
corresponding party and electoral process.

At the same time, her return puts the NXIVM episode back on the table — not as
a criminal accusation, which the sources consulted do not support, but as a
relevant political precedent, given her documented relationship with the
organization and the explanations Flores offered publicly during the 2021
campaign.
